tagline: Enabling the security, stability, and resiliency of the internet
hero_kpi_rationale: The total number of .com and .net domain names under management is the primary structural driver of recurring revenue, reflecting Verisign's monopolistic position in global internet infrastructure.

kpis.name: Domain Name Base
kpis.explanation: Total number of .com and .net domain names registered and managed by Verisign.
kpis.description: The base reached 173.5 million at end-2025, up 2.6% year-on-year, supported by e-commerce and internet adoption.
kpis.signal: Stable base growth, a key indicator of underlying internet demand.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue generated primarily from domain name registration fees.
kpis.description: Revenue of $1,656.6 million in 2025, driven by recurring fees from .com and .net registrations.
kpis.signal: Solid 6% growth, aligned with domain name base expansion.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from core operations before taxes.
kpis.description: Operating income of $1,121 million in 2025, up 6%.
kpis.signal: High and stable operating margin, reflecting the efficiency of the business model.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin after cost of services.
kpis.description: Calculated as 100% minus 11.8% (cost of revenue), resulting in 88.2% in 2025, an improvement from 87.7% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Very high gross margin, typical of a high fixed-cost, high variable-margin model.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.description: 67.7% in 2025, slightly down from 67.9% in 2024, despite revenue growth.
kpis.signal: Very high operating margin, among the strongest in the technology sector.

kpis.name: R&D (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: 6.3% of revenue in 2025, slightly up from 6.2% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Moderate R&D investment level, consistent with a mature infrastructure model.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from core operating activities.
kpis.description: $1,091.1 million in 2025, compared to $901.7 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Very strong 21% growth, outpacing revenue growth.

kpis.name: Renewal Rate (.com/.net)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of domain names renewed upon expiration.
kpis.description: Final Q3 2025 rate at 75.4%, compared to 72.2% a year earlier.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in retention rate, an indicator of customer loyalty.

kpis.name: New Registrations
kpis.explanation: Number of new .com and .net domain names registered during the year.
kpis.description: 41.7 million in 2025, compared to 37.4 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Strong rebound in new registrations, signaling dynamic demand.

kpis.name: Quarterly Dividend
kpis.explanation: Amount of dividend paid per share each quarter.
kpis.description: Dividend increased to $0.81 per share in February 2026, up 5.2%.
kpis.signal: Dividend increase, reflecting strength in cash generation.

risks.title: Increasing sophisticated cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: Ranked as the top risk, strong language reflecting critical importance. Repeated mention of advanced attacks (zero-day, APT). Highly critical category for an operator of critical internet infrastructure.

risks.title: Vulnerabilities in third-party systems and software
risks.score_rationale: Central risk related to vendors and external components. Inability to guarantee absolute security against third-party flaws. Direct impact on service continuity and reputation.

risks.title: Rising social engineering attacks
risks.score_rationale: Growing frequency of phishing and social engineering attacks. No absolute security possible despite employee training. High impact on system access.

risks.title: Internet routing system failures (BGP/RPKI)
risks.score_rationale: Critical systemic risk to internet infrastructure. Vulnerabilities in BGP can lead to massive connectivity outages. Partial dependencies outside the company's control.

risks.title: Data center outages or system disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Critical operational risk related to data center concentration. Potential loss of service and transactions without dedicated insurance. Critical dependence on physical infrastructure.

risks.title: Large-scale denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks
risks.score_rationale: Increasing frequency and size of DDoS attacks. High mitigation costs. Direct impact on service availability and SLA commitments.

ai_positioning.summary: Verisign did not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report. Therefore, there is no clear AI positioning.
